backcard_card_text:
[Auto][Once per turn] When you use a yellow card in a combo, draw 1 card.
[Activate : Main/Battle][Once per turn] Place 2 of your Z-Energy in your Drop : Choose up to 1 of your yellow 《Shadow Dragon》 cards with the [EX-Evolve] skill and switch it to Active Mode.
[Activate : Battle](Yellow), choose 1 《Shadow Dragon》 card with 1 power in your Combo Area : Play up to 1 yellow 《Shadow Dragon》 card with the same character name as the chosen card and an energy cost of 4 from your hand or Drop with its skills negated for the game.
card_set: ZENKAI Series EX Set 08 LEGEND OF THE DRAGON BALLS [DBS-B25]
card_text:
[Permanent] This card can’t attack.
[Activate : Main] Add 1 yellow card from your hand to your Z-Energy and switch this card to Rest Mode : Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 yellow 《Shadow Dragon》 card to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, or you have 2 or more energy and a yellow Z-Unison with a specified cost of 1 in play : Switch this card and up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, place up to 1 {7 Shadow Dragons Assembled} from your Z-Deck in your Battle Area, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
